notices.short_title: Emergency Rule Regarding 2026 Summer Event Permit Applications
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation has adopted an emergency rule governing applications for permits for summer 2026 events, according to a notice published March 31, 2026.

notices.short_title: PRE-SOLICITATION CONFERENCE  BID 2600057 - APPARATUS, 100' REAR MOUNT AERIAL  FDNY
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services is seeking bids for Bid 2600057, a 100-foot rear-mount aerial apparatus for the Fire Department, with the lowest qualified bid winning and responses due April 28, 2026.

The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded WB Mason Co., Inc. an $8.5 million contract for multipurpose paper for the central storehouse, chosen through competitive sealed bids in which the lowest qualified bid wins.

The Department of Citywide Administrative Services is seeking bids for heating, ventilation, air conditioning and chiller repair services, with the lowest qualified bid to win and responses due June 2, 2026.

notices.short_title: TRUCKS, ASPHALT CEMENT DISTRIBUTION FOR THE CITY OF NEW YORK
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded Diehl & Sons Inc a $4.6 million contract for trucks for asphalt cement distribution for New York City, selected through competitive sealed bids in which the lowest qualified bid wins.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: Shelter services for Homeless Families with Children
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration plans to renew its contract for shelter services for homeless families with children, with responses due April 2, 2026.

notices.short_title: Engineering and Project Management Services for the Repair of Marine Vessel Hunts Point (EMER_EHSINV-MV-CM)
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection awarded Crowley Engineering Services Inc a $1.3 million emergency purchase contract for engineering and project management services to repair a marine vessel at Hunts Point.
The Fire Department awarded Avco Enterprises Dentserve a $111,959 contract for training manikins, using a noncompetitive small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business.

notices.short_title: Imm Emerg Demo at 147-07 Guy R Brewer Blvd, Queens (E-7335/ DQ00291)
notices.plain: The Department of Housing Preservation and Development awarded Granite Environmental LLC a $305,368 emergency contract, bought without the usual competition, for immediate demolition of a building at 147-07 Guy R. Brewer Blvd. in Queens.

notices.short_title: Emergency Demolition at 4234 Carpenter Avenue, Bronx - DQ00288/ E-7332
notices.plain: The Department of Housing Preservation and Development awarded Statewide Demolition Corp an emergency purchase contract worth $312,851 for demolition work at 4234 Carpenter Avenue in the Bronx.

notices.short_title: QG-125M Queens Emerald Ash Borer (EAB) Related Tree Removal FY25, Queens
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation awarded Looks Great Services Inc a $3,039,132 construction contract, chosen through competitive sealed bids, to remove trees in Queens affected by the emerald ash borer.

notices.short_title: Queens Street Tree Planting FY25 in CBs 7 & 8, QG-124M
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation awarded HMD Construction Group LLC a $999,000 contract for street tree planting in Queens Community Boards 7 and 8, through a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business made without competition.

notices.short_title: Environmental and Regulatory Compliance Services in Connection with Safety Training and Review of Site Safety Plan
notices.plain: The School Construction Authority is seeking proposals from vendors for environmental and regulatory compliance services covering safety training and review of site safety plans, with responses due April 1, 2026.

notices.short_title: FY26 Staten Island Business Solutions Center NAE
notices.plain: The Department of Small Business Services awarded Educational Data Systems Inc a $305,700 contract through a Negotiated Acquisition, which means negotiating with one or a few vendors instead of open competition, for services tied to a Staten Island Business Solutions Center in fiscal year 2026.
The Department of Youth and Community Development intends to award a human services contract called FY27 NAE COMPASS Explorer through a negotiated acquisition, with responses due April 1, 2026.

The Department of Youth and Community Development awarded The Fortune Society Inc a $2.3 million contract for its FY26 CRED Program, selected through a Negotiated Acquisition from a Pre-Qualified List of vendors approved in advance.
The Department of Youth and Community Development intends to award a contract for payroll services, with responses due April 1, 2026.
The Campaign Finance Board published a notice on March 31, 2026, under its public comment on contract awards, titled "Pay Parity Analysis.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration published a notice on March 31, 2026, in the Public Comment on Contract Awards section, with the title "Affordable Housing.

The Bronx County District Attorney's Office is buying Chainalysis investigations software through an Intergovernmental Purchase, meaning a contract another government already holds, according to a notice published March 31, 2026.

The Bronx District Attorney's Office published a notice on March 31, 2026, about a contract for document generation services from Legito, selected through negotiated acquisition with one or a few vendors instead of open competition.
The Fire Department is seeking public comment on its contract award for overhead repair door services in the Bronx and Manhattan.

The Department of Information Technology and Telecommunications published a notice on March 31, 2026, about a contract titled "7-858-0784A-NG911 Business Process SME SP3," which the notice names without describing the work, vendor or amount.

notices.short_title: Q363-124M Northern Playground Basketball Court and Handball Court Reconstruction
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation has published a notice on public comment about contract awards for reconstructing the basketball and handball courts at Northern Playground, under procurement number Q363-124M.

The Landmarks Preservation Commission will hold a public hearing on April 14, 2026, to consider its agenda of items.
The City Record published its monthly index for February 2026, a list of the month's entries in the city's official journal of contracts, hearings and rules.
